title: PF1 Combat Maneuvers
description: Makes Pathfinder 1e combat maneuvers into first-class, individually addressable things: a registry of maneuver types, per-maneuver CMB and CMD change targets, a maneuver picker on the CMB button, a Combat Maneuvers category on the combat tab, and automatic weapon-type/group tagging so bonus modules can target a single maneuver.

requires.reason: Used to extend PF1's change-target resolution, actor data preparation and actor sheet safely, so the mod coexists with other modules that touch the same methods.

recommends.reason: Optional integration: maneuver items are tagged with a weapon base type named after the maneuver (Trip, Bull Rush) and a weapon group (Deft Maneuvers, Powerful Maneuvers), so roll-bonuses can target bonuses at a single maneuver or at a group of them. The mod is fully functional without it.
